title: Read an attached file
description: `{ path, sheet?, range? }`: the attached file, and for an Excel file which sheet and which cells.

path.description: The attached file: `.visionboard/attachments/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<n>-<name>`, or a file in a folder this tool made. Any other path is refused.

sheet.description: Excel: the sheet to read; left out, the list of sheets.

range.description: Excel, with `sheet`: the cells, such as `B2:F20` or `B2`; left out, the whole sheet up to the cap.
